# jwk Provider

Provider for converting JWK (JSON Web Key) to PEM format

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    jwk = {
      source = "michaelkosir/jwk"
    }
  }
}

# No configuration is required for the jwk provider
provider "jwk" {}
```
